Newest Item Studio for each Minecraft version. Pick the file that matches your game:

- `item-studio-...+mc1.21.11.jar` for **Minecraft 1.21.11** (Java 21)
- `item-studio-...+mc26.2.jar` for **Minecraft 26.2** (Java 25)

Put it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder together with Fabric API for the same version.
In game press **Right Shift**, or click **Item Studio** in the pause menu.
